scenes.label: Who
scenes.headline: Hello — I'm *Aryan*
scenes.text: Full-Stack Developer and AI/ML Engineer based in the Greater Delhi Area, studying BCA with an AI and ML specialization at Galgotias University.

scenes.label: Why
scenes.headline: Problems *first*
scenes.text: From cattle classification for the Rashtriya Gokul Mission to mental-health platforms for students, I start from a real problem, not a tech demo.

scenes.label: How
scenes.headline: Built to *ship*
scenes.text: My work has been presented at government missions and industry events, which shaped how I approach every project: build to ship, not just to demo.

scenes.label: Proof
scenes.headline: On *stage*
scenes.text: IEEE Code Astraa 2025 finalist, Smart India Hackathon 2024 and 2025, and a live presentation to 2,000+ stakeholders at UP International Trade Show 2024.

scenes.label: Next
scenes.headline: What's *next*
scenes.text: Currently seeking internship opportunities to build impactful products at scale, and open to freelance work.

steps.title: Understand the problem
steps.text: Talk to the people who have it. Farmers, students and shelters shaped my last projects more than any spec.

steps.title: Build the smallest real thing
steps.text: Get a working model or app in front of users early, then improve it with what they actually do.

steps.title: Ship and present
steps.text: Deploy it, measure it, and explain it clearly, whether to a hackathon jury or 2,000 people at a trade show.

faq.question: Are you open to internships?
faq.answer: Yes. I'm actively seeking internship opportunities in full-stack and AI/ML engineering, remote or in the Greater Delhi Area.

faq.question: Do you take freelance projects?
faq.answer: Yes. I take on web apps, AI/ML prototypes and portfolio sites. Use the contact form and tell me what you're building.

faq.question: What do you work with most?
faq.answer: Python, React, Node.js, FastAPI, TensorFlow, LangChain, OpenCV and TypeScript day to day.

faq.question: Where are you based?
faq.answer: Greater Delhi Area, India (IST). I work with people in any time zone.
